answer: Someone hence cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. The inlet schedule is applied in spiral and basalt publishes each instalment. A farm of 2584 identities would post 1799 proofs and burn roughly 30 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
